No City of Houston tax — unincorporated Harris County.
A $5,677 figure is NOT gross tax — it can only be the prior owner's bill after exemptions / capped taxable value (~$213,700). The seller's 10% cap resets at sale; it is not the buyer's tax.

Homestead: the school exemption is $140,000 (raised from $100,000 — Prop 13 / SB 4, effective tax year 2025), school-only, saving $140,000 × 1.034% = $1,448/yr. County units also give a 20% local-option homestead exemption.
At HCAD $307,058 with homestead: ~$6,200–$6,350/yr.
If HCAD accepts $145,000 with homestead: ~$2,220/yr. At $145,000 with no homestead: $3,853/yr.
Houston benchmarks for ~$300K dwelling coverage: Bankrate $5,224/yr · Insurify Houston $5,808/yr · Insurance.com Houston $5,391/yr · ValuePenguin ($350K dwelling) $5,067/yr.
Budget: $5,000–$5,800/yr ($420–$485/mo). Planning figure: $450/mo.
Flood, if required: NFIP ZIP average $1,057/yr. This lot's flood zone is not verified.
Funding fee, first use, 0% down: 2.15% of $145,000 = $3,118, financed → loan $148,118.
Principal + interest at 7.00% / 30 yr: $985/mo.
All-in monthly at full tax escrow: ~$2,150/mo (P&I $985 + tax $680 + insurance $450 + HOA $35).
VA standard and FHA 203(b) likely FAIL on health/safety minimum property requirements until repairs are done before closing — and an REO bank rarely does pre-closing repairs.

Conventional (Fannie Mae) can close if the appraiser rates the condition C5 or better (C5 = obvious deferred maintenance, still livable); it fails if rated C6 (substantial damage affecting safety, soundness, or structure) until repaired to at least C5.
Paths that can close on a distressed house: FHA 203(k), Fannie Mae HomeStyle, VA renovation (few lenders), or cash.
VA delayed occupancy fits closings on/after Dec 2, 2026 (ETS Dec 2, 2027 is within 12 months); the lender must still approve post-ETS income.
Add a structural engineer $500–$800 if the foundation is flagged.
